Based on the evidence gathered:

- For "page 1 line 1" (Torque wrench 40-200 Nm), the invoice unit price is 92.19 EUR, while the PO unit price is 89.50 EUR, resulting in an over-billed amount of 1,076 minor currency units (EUR).
- For "page 1 line 2" (Safety goggles, anti-fog), the invoice billed 10 units, but only 7 units were received, resulting in an over-billed amount of 1,860 minor currency units (EUR).

Given these findings, I will propose a credit memo request for the over-billed amounts.

Action: 
draft_credit_memo_request for the over-billed lines "page 1 line 1" and "page 1 line 2" with the reason "price variance and short shipment".

This action will address the discrepancies found in the invoice.
